item.title: What Eli Lilly’s new employer platform could mean for access to weight-loss drugs
item.description: Eli Lilly wants to get its obesity drugs into the hands of more Americans and it’s betting on employers to help do so. item.description: On February 27, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth took the unprecedented step of designating a U.S. firm—Anthropic—as a supply chain risk. Anthropic’s crime?
